text: The creation of the body and bulk of that business is shared by everyone who has anything to do with it. No manufacturer can say: "I built this business", if he has required the help of thousands of men in building it. It is a joint production. Everyone employed in it has contributed something to it.
author: Henry Ford
reference: My Life and Work (with Samuel Crowther)
locator: Chapter IV, The Secret of Manufacturing and Serving
